accessibility.contrast_ratio: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for text against dark background.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-400 focus:outline-none.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons. Use data-testid on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a sidebar layout for the dashboard to accommodate the extensive feature set (Scan, Avatar, PRQ, Cards, Games, Coach, Education).
Use strict dark mode. The UI should feel like a high-tech medical or athletic lab. Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm max), thin 1px borders, and high contrast.
Do NOT use standard card shadows. Use subtle borders (border-white/10) and glowing accents (cyan) for active states.
Typography: Use Barlow Condensed for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Install these via Google Fonts.
Use purely HTML/Tailwind for structural bento grid layouts; rely on Shadcn for complex interactives (select, dialog).
For the PRQ (Performance Readiness Quotient) metrics, use a large monospace font (JetBrains Mono) to look like clinical data readouts.
The 19 game modes can be presented in a horizontal scroll or a dense bento grid, avoiding generic lists.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case-role.
